verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The scanner now spans PN_PREFIX internal dots, requires a non-dot final prefix character before treating the run as a prefixed name, and skips the complete local part. The focused unit cases cover dotted prefix and non-prefix boundaries, while the integration regression uses a valid declared `filtr.x:` prefix plus an unrelated unclosed WHERE block, proving the real CanaryFailed path produces no false suggestion. The implementation remains diagnostic-only: suggestions are computed after both query and update parsing fail and never modify the returned SPARQL. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect remains in the diff-scoped change.
